title: E1 Short Conversations and Exam Run-Through – Lesson Audio

scripts.label: Script A – Where are they? Eight sentences (AM slide 3)
lines: One. Your class is in Room 6.
Three. How much are the apples?
Six. Two kilos of rice, please.
questions: 1 college; 2 doctor; 3 market; 4 home; 5 doctor; 6 market; 7 college; 8 home

scripts.label: Script B – College conversation (Handout 12A Section A, Text 1)
lines: Hello. Are you a new student?
Yes, I am. My name is Hana.
Welcome, Hana. Your class is in Room 6.
questions: Is Hana a new student? (Yes, she is.)
Which room is her class in? (Room 6)

scripts.label: Script C – Doctor conversation (Handout 12A Section A, Text 2)
lines: Good morning. What is the problem?
Take this medicine two times a day.
questions: Does the man have a headache? (No, he doesn't.)
How many times a day does he take the medicine? (Two times)

scripts.label: Script D – Spell it and say the number (AM slide 11)
lines: Number one. K, H, A, N. Khan.
Number two. G, R, A, C, E. Grace.
Number three. My phone number is oh seven seven double oh, nine double oh, four six one.

scripts.label: Script E – In the street (PM slide 5)
lines: Hi Sara. Where are you going?
What do you want to buy?
questions: Is Sara going to college? (No, she isn't.)
What does she want to buy? (Fish and rice)

scripts.label: Script F – At home, one speaker (PM slide 5)
lines: I live in a small flat. I live with my brother. He is a bus driver. On Sunday we cook together. I like Sunday.
questions: Does the speaker live with a brother? (Yes, he does.)
What do they do on Sunday? (They cook together.)

scripts.label: Script G – Phone message about a picnic (PM slide 5)
lines: Hello, Sam. This is Anna. The picnic is on Sunday. We meet at the park at twelve o'clock. Bring some food and a drink. See you there!
questions: Is the picnic on Saturday? (No, it isn't. It's on Sunday.)
What time do they meet? (Twelve o'clock)

scripts.label: Script H – In the shop (PM slide 5)
lines: Excuse me. Do you have milk?
Yes, we do. It's by the door.
questions: Does the shop have milk? (Yes, it does.)

scripts.label: Script I – At the bus stop (PM run-through, Round 1)
lines: Excuse me. Is this the bus to the station?
No, it isn't. This is the bus to the market.
Which bus goes to the station?
questions: Is this the bus to the station? (No, it isn't.)
Which bus goes to the station? (The number twelve)

scripts.label: Script J – Message from the college (PM run-through, Round 2)
lines: Hello, this is Hackney College. Your English class is in Room eight. It starts at ten o'clock. Please bring a pen. Thank you.
questions: Is the English class in Room six? (No, it isn't. It's Room eight.)
What time does it start? (Ten o'clock)
